ice: A gas or liquid, normally water, which has been frozen (made solid)
When water is cooled below 0°C, it freezes into ice.
If you ice something, you cool it by putting ice or something else very cold on it.
I iced my knee after I hurt it in soccer.
If you ice a cake, you cover with icing.
If you ice someone, you murder them.
icon: An image, picture, or other representation of something.
A religious painting that is often done on wooden panels.
A person or thing that is the best example of something.
That man is an icon in the business; he is loyal and has good business sense.
A small picture which represents something (such as an icon on a computer screen).
Click on the icon to open the program.
A type of noun where the form reflects and is determined by the referent; onomatopoeic words are all icons.
iceland: Iceland is an island country in the northern Atlantic Ocean. Iceland is halfway between Europe and North America.
icebox: An icebox is a box that contains ice.
, An icebox is a container in a refrigerator.
iceberg: An iceberg is a very large piece of ice floating in the sea
icicle: A icicle is a hanging, tapering long piece of ice down from a roof covered with snow.
iconic: If something (a phenomenon or an event) has once become famous, it is iconic.
icy: If something is icy it is covered with ice.
Be careful, the sidewalk is icy.
icosagon: An icosagon is a shape that has 20 sides and 20 angles.
icelandic: Icelandic is a language spoken by around 330 thousand people, mainly in Iceland.
If something is Icelandic, it is about Iceland or the people living there.
If someone is an Icelandic, he or she is from Iceland.
iconify: If you iconify something, you make it into an icon.
If you iconify something, add icons to it.
icositetragon: A icositetragon is a shape with twenty four sides.
icosihenagon: A icosihenagon is a shape with twenty one sides.
icositetrahedron: A icositetrahedron is a polyhedron with twenty four faces.
icosidodecahedron: A icosidodecahedron is a polyhedron with thirty two faces.
icily: If someone talks to you icily, they talk to you in a very cold, unfriendly, or distant way.
